literal: Firmness in action is called a person's firmness of mind; all other things are different.
translation: What is called firmness in action is in truth a person's firmness of mind; all other external assets are of a different, lesser nature.
modern: செயல் உறுதி என்று சொல்லப்படுவது ஒருவனுடைய மன உறுதியே ஆகும்; மற்றவை எல்லாம் அதற்கு வேறானவை.
explanation: This couplet defines the true source of strength required to accomplish any task. The poet states that 'vinai-t-tiṭpam' (resoluteness in action) is nothing other than 'mana-t-tiṭpam' (resoluteness of mind). Without an unwavering mind, no external resources, wealth, or planning can bring success. All other external aids are secondary and do not constitute true, reliable strength.
